description: Core source file for jQuery library, defining the main jQuery function, prototype methods, utility functions, and internal variables.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the jQuery object into a true array.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the DOM element at the specified index or all elements as an array.

methods.name: pushStack
methods.description: Creates a new jQuery object from an array of elements, maintaining chainability.

methods.name: each
methods.description: Iterates over the matched elements, executing a callback.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Transforms each element in the set via a callback.

methods.name: slice
methods.description: Creates a new jQuery object from a subset of the matched elements.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Gets the first element in the set.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Gets the last element in the set.

methods.name: eq
methods.description: Gets the element at the specified index.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Ends the most recent filtering operation in the chain.
